name: Countermeasure 2
summary: We thought we were safe. We thought our enemies were defeated after we eliminated their missile silos and defenses. But we were wrong. Through various sources, we've learned that a new sleeper cell has been activated and they have double the destructive capabilities! Once again, they have initiated a missile launch targeting Washington D.C. Your mission is to infiltrate enemy territory, crack the FailSafe Code, and stop the launch.
